facts.label: Agora e planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para o agora e am/is/are going to + verbo para o plano: I’m walking around now. I’m going to check the doors.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + verbo-ing: I’m walking around the building. Use now ou right now para deixar claro.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo base: I’m going to check the doors. Diga a hora: at midnight, at two o’clock.
